says: An ended tile's wait error reads its name again at once, and a still-ended name writes a new wait at once, so a wait the connection refuses immediately loops read and wait with no timer.
proof: WindowMachine.ts:499 sends the ended tile to resolveAgain on wait_err; WindowMachine.ts:404 writes the next wait in the same step when the fold is still ended; transport/Connection.ts:57 and :199 refuse a wait past 64 parked waits with too_many_waits at once.
cost: Only with 64 or more parked waits on one connection; none at today's tile counts.
